decisions.decision: 13-01 used concat(runPhase(value), source) instead of the plan's sketched switchMap to resubscribe the source after an auth phase resolves
decisions.rationale: runPhase returns an ignoreElements()-wrapped Observable<never> — it never emits next, so switchMap's projector would never fire. concat waits for phase completion then resubscribes, which is the intended semantics. Recorded in 13-01-SUMMARY.md under Decisions Made. Downstream plans 13-02/04/05/06 call this.authRetryOperator(...) rather than re-sketching the operator, so this does not recur.

decisions.decision: 13-01 marked no requirements complete in REQUIREMENTS.md
decisions.rationale: Foundation-only plan. RAUTH-01/03/04/06/07 all describe wired end-to-end behavior delivered by 13-02 through 13-06. Mirrors the INVITE-01 / WIRE-08 precedent of not claiming a requirement until its implementing plan lands.
